{{Short description|Statistician}} 

'''Peter Guttorp''' is a statistician, born in Sweden, with most of his career in the United States. He is a professor emeritus at the [[University of Washington]]<ref>{{Cite web|title=People, Department of Statistics, University of Washington|url=https://stat.uw.edu/about-us/people/peter-guttorp}}</ref> and professor at the [[Norwegian Computing Center]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Peter Guttorp|url=https://nr.no/en/employees/peter-guttorp/|access-date=2021-07-13|website=NR|language=en-US}}</ref> Most of his work is in stochastic modeling of scientific data in hematology, geosciences, and climatology, with particular focus on spatial and spatio-temporal approaches. He has also worked in the history of statistics.

Guttorp received a journalist exam from the Stockholm School of Journalism in 1969, and a PhD in Statistics from the [[University of California at Berkeley]] in 1980.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Peter Malte Guttorp {{!}} Department of Statistics|url=https://statistics.berkeley.edu/people/peter-malte-guttorp|access-date=2021-07-13|website=statistics.berkeley.edu}}</ref> He was awarded an honorary doctorate from [[Lund University]] in 2009.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Hedersdoktorer genom åren|url=https://www.lth.se/omlth/hedersdoktorer/hedersdoktorer-genom-aaren/|access-date=2021-07-13|website=Lunds tekniska högskola|language=sv}}</ref>

Guttorp is a fellow of the [[American Statistical Association]],<ref>{{Cite web|title=ASA Fellows List|url=https://www.amstat.org/ASA/Your-Career/Awards/ASA-Fellows-list.aspx|access-date=2021-02-23|website=www.amstat.org}}</ref> and the [[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Institute of Mathematical Statistics {{!}} Honored IMS Fellows|url=https://imstat.org/honored-ims-fellows/|access-date=2021-02-23|language=en}}</ref> He is an elected member of the [[International Statistical Institute]]<ref>{{Cite web|title=ISI Elected Members - ISI|url=https://www.isi-web.org/about-isi/who-is-isi/members/indivual/isi-elected-members|access-date=2021-02-23|website=www.isi-web.org}}</ref> and served on its executive committee as vice president from 2017 to 2021.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Executive Committee - ISI|url=https://www.isi-web.org/about-isi/who-is-isi/executive-committee|access-date=2021-07-13|website=www.isi-web.org|archive-date=2021-11-30|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211130122341/https://www.isi-web.org/about-isi/who-is-isi/executive-committee|url-status=dead}}</ref> He was president of the International Environmetric Society from 2002 to 2004.<ref>{{Cite web|title="The reason I do statistics is I'm interested in so many different things": An interview with Peter Guttorp|url=https://www.statisticsviews.com/article/the-reason-i-do-statistics-is-im-interested-in-so-many-different-things-an-interview-with-peter-guttorp/|access-date=2021-07-13|website=Stats & Data Science Views|language=en-GB}}</ref>

* [https://www.springer.com/gp/book/9781461413431 P. Guttorp and D. R. Brillinger (2011): ''Selected works of David Brillinger''. New York: Springer.]
